engineering_quality.title: Engineering Quality
engineering_quality.subtitle: Quality signals a reviewer can validate in the running app and the repo today.

cards.title: Trust boundaries stay explicit
cards.summary: Auth/session handling, transport code, app policy, and storage integration stay in their own lanes so security-sensitive behavior does not blur across layers.
points: App services consume traits, not SQL primitives.
Domain types carry invariants at compile time.
HTTP handlers stay focused on protocol concerns.

cards.title: Runtime behavior is inspectable
cards.summary: The page exposes runtime surfaces that let a reviewer inspect backend behavior during normal interaction instead of relying on architecture claims alone.
points: Live logs stream backend events without manual refresh.
Network traces show request shape and timing in context.
Interactive demos can be correlated against transport output.

cards.title: Guardrails catch drift early
cards.summary: Architecture, component, and fixture conventions are checked by scripts so regressions get caught before merge.
points: Datastar command and SSE conventions are verified in CI.
Component composition and naming rules are enforced.
Shared content fixtures are validated before render.
